newsitem.title: USA: Grossman's gets $50 mln in DIP financing.
newsitem.headline: Grossman's gets $50 mln in DIP financing.

text.p: Grossman's Inc said Thursday it resolved issues related to an arrangement with GDI Co Inc to provide up to $50 million in debtor-in- possession (DIP) financing.

The DIP financing begins in full April 29, Grossman's said. Until then, Congress Financial Corp will continue to provide financing to Grossman's according to terms the two companies agreed upon before Grossman's filed for bankruptcy on Monday.
In addition, GDI agreed to advance to Grossman's $11 million prior to April 21, including $4 million advanced today, Grossman's said.
A final hearing on approval of the DIP financing has been scheduled for April 30 in Delaware bankruptcy court.
A $1 million termination fee claimed by Congress under the pre-petition revolving credit agreement has been secured by a senior lien on inventory and receivables, Grossman's said.
The fee is disputed and will be determined at a later date, Grossman's said.
